name: capacity-connect
description: Capacity Connect - Digital Capacity Building & Competency Management Platform for IMD (MoES)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
